title: FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE UNDER PMAY-G
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Rural Development

FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE UNDER PMAY-G

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
24 JUL 2026 5:44PM by PIB Delhi

Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana–Gramin (PMAY-G) is reviewed through Performance Review Committee (PRC) Meetings, Empowered Committee (EC) Meetings, Common Review Mission (CRM), Area Officers Schemes, Reports of National Level Monitors etc. besides regular field visits by the officers of the Ministry. Recently, the Empowered Committee (EC) Meetings have been held in the month of March 2026. Further, the State-wise details of houses sanctioned, completed and pending as of June, 2026 are provided in
Annexure – I.

The Government has approved the implementation of the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) with the unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in North Eastern States, Hilly States (including UTs of J&K and Ladakh). In addition to the unit assistance provided under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹12,000 is extended for the construction of toilets through convergence with the Swachh Bharat Mission–Gramin (SBM-G). Further, there is a provision for providing prescribed person-days of unskilled wage employment within the approved scheme parameters, at prevailing wage rates to each PMAY-G beneficiary for the construction of their house through convergence with MGNREGS/ VB G-RAM G.

This information was given by Minister of State for
 the Rural Development
,
Dr. Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani
 in a written reply in Rajya Sabha today.
